labels.name: bug
labels.rationale: Reports unexpected Live behaviour (deadlock) with redirected stdout/stderr.

labels.name: more information needed
labels.rationale: No runnable example or diagnose output; stack dumps alone cannot reproduce it.

body:
A minimal runnable example that reproduces the hang would help most: a short script that uses `Live` with `redirect_stdout=True` and `redirect_stderr=True` and `auto_refresh=True`, and prints or logs from another thread while the display refreshes. Stack dumps and lock-order analysis are useful, but they cannot be run, so the deadlock cannot be confirmed from them yet.

Please also paste the output of `python -m rich.diagnose`, since you listed Rich 14.2.0 on Linux. Redirection is described in the Live docs:
https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/live.rst

Related earlier report: #3125.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
